title: Material Blend 2-Mix Solo #01 (흑요암금+보태니컬)
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

THE ABSOLUTE DARKEST BLACK SKIN ON EARTH blue-black void complexion darker than night sky, late 30s goddess, wide hip narrow physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — hips so impossibly wide extending beyond frame creating the most extreme hip-to-waist ratio ever, waist cinched to absolute impossible minimum, upper body slim emphasizing the dramatic hip explosion, long sleek jet-black hair cascading past hips — her entire body, from neck to ankle, is a random intermingled mix of two materials with no spatial division at all — not left versus right, not top versus bottom, but irregular patches of each scattered all over her body in a marbled, organic distribution, exactly like natural mineral veining. polished obsidian stone fused directly to her own form, solid glossy black stone curving to follow her body's true shape, with molten gold seams running between fitted stone sections and living orchid blooms growing directly from her own skin, every stem rooted in her living skin and every petal standing in three-dimensional relief casting its own small shadow, BLAZING VIOLET blossoms, VIVID GOLD leaves and tendrils are woven through each other everywhere: a patch of one material on one shoulder, immediately beside it a patch of the other, then the first again across the ribs, the second at the hip, the first down one thigh, the second across the opposite calf — the two materials never separating into a clean zone anywhere on her body, every square inch densely interlocking, no fabric no seam no garment anywhere, every material fused to or erupting from her own living skin, covering her completely with no bare skin anywhere from neck to ankle. Pose: full frontal, both hands framing the face, chin raised — most extreme wide hip narrow silhouette ever displayed.
extreme platform heels/boots blending the relevant materials at her feet, extra long nails each matching whichever zone that hand falls in.

MANDATORY pure pitch black void background only, absolutely NO studio backdrop NO texture NO grey NO gradient. ONE woman only. Extreme macro detail on every material and every blended transition. Pattern density MAXIMUM — zero bare skin anywhere from neck to ankle. 8K portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
